What I did check:

- The schedule would be weekdays at 17:30 America/Chicago (the company time zone). Today, 2026-10-14, is a Wednesday, so the first post would be today at 17:30 CT.
- The digest would list only today's new messages in #strategic-pod and post them back to that channel, so nothing from other channels or your DMs would be included.

Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll set it up. I can also post today's digest by hand at 17:30 if that helps in the meantime.
